1135: The front of his coat was so short it left all importance to the waistcoat, the back so long that its swallow tails almost touched the ground, his high sugar loaf hat had a big rosette in it and he possessed an infinite number of different coloured striped cravattes and of walking canes, which he hung on to his arm by a gold chain or catgut strap.
There were bucks dressed in the extreme of fashion, with enormously long tails to their coats, immense cravattes, high boots, sugar loaf hats, canes fastened to their wrists and spying glasses.
